mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the GDP chained price index (GDPC1) above 17500 in the next month signals strong demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 17500 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 crosses above 17500, or the effect diminishes below 0.5% over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) simultaneously signal a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 5000 and UNRATE falls below 4.0% in the same month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or the interaction effect between PAYEMS and UNRATE does not consistently predict positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In a tightening cycle, 60-day returns are not negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.0%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its current level indicates supply-side strength, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO's increase does not correlate with positive returns within 5 days, or the effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST (industrial production) crossing above 1200 in the next month signals demand recovery, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above 1200 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive when HOUST crosses above 1200, or the effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward momentum in employment (PAYEMS) and downward pressure on unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) in the same month strengthens labor market confidence, driving positive returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 15000 and UNRATE falls below 4.0% in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE does not consistently predict positive returns over 60 days, or Rank IC < 0.03 in any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, industrial production (INDPRO) crossing above 107 signals supply-side acceleration, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above 107 in the next month
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, 20-day returns are not positive when INDPRO crosses above 107, or the effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
